applicability.rationale: The report is a systematic review and its methods documentation is directly relevant to transparency.
The declared reporting overlay applies to the systematic-review flow information described in the manuscript.
The supplied record does not identify a materially unsupported synthetic claim.

evidence_anchor.claim: The manuscript omits full-text exclusion counts and reasons, although the retained screening log contains them.

remedy.cost_tradeoffs: Requires extracting and documenting retained log details; no new screening is needed.
remedy.minimum_action: Report the full-text exclusion counts and reasons from the retained screening log in the review-flow documentation.

findings.scholarly_relevance: Omitting recoverable full-text exclusion information prevents readers from fully auditing how the included evidence set was derived.
